message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise complaints through the city’s official channels. Noise violations are governed by the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** and the **Atlanta Police Department** (APD), which enforce the city’s noise ordinance.

### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Identify the source** – Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential building, commercial property, construction site, or public event. | — |
| 2 | **Gather details** – Record the date, time, location, and description of the noise. If possible, take audio or video evidence (but avoid recording police officers or private property without permission). | — |
| 3 | **Contact the appropriate agency** | |
|   • **Residential or commercial noise** | Call the **Code Enforcement Hotline** at **(404) 656‑4000** or submit a complaint online via the City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal. |
|   • **Construction or industrial noise** | Call the **Construction Services Division** at **(404) 656‑4000** or use the online portal. |
|   • **Public event or festival noise** | Contact the **Event Management Office** at **(404) 656‑4000**. |
| 4 | **Submit the complaint** | Use the online form: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/portal/atlantaga/portal/site/atlantaga/menuitem.
